ways.label: Bottom Gordon Hut via Severn and Saxton Huts and Top Gordon Hut back to Bottom Gordon Hut
evidence: It starts at Bottom Gordon Hut in the Leatham Conservation Area, and travels via Severn and Saxton Huts in the Molesworth Recreation Reserve, around to Top Gordon Hut and back to Bottom Gordon Hut.
Access to the start of this loop route is via Leatham Road, which is approximately 70 km from Blenheim on SH63 heading towards St Arnaud.
The track continues on the true left for the final section along some flats and across a swing bridge back to Bottom Gordon Hut.

doubts: Severn Hut, Saxton Hut, the Severn and Saxton rivers and the locally named Boundary Stream have no entries in the packet, so their refs are null (the 'Boundary' entry T4 is a peak, not the stream). Team Hut is passed on the way but is 'not for public accommodation', so it is in the via list but not in huts. Between Severn Hut and Boundary Stream the route crosses an unnamed high point (1764 m) given only by grid reference. The page describes the loop in one order (Leatham, Severn, Saxton, Gordon) and requires Saxton travel to be upstream only during 1 January to 30 April, but it does not use the words clockwise or anticlockwise, so direction is null.
